paragraphs: Yehoshua ben Kafotai (כפותאי), Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law — [Shabbat 147a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.147a.10).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: This notice spells the name כפותאי (Kafotai). The William Davidson vocalized text of Shabbat 147a has כפוסאי (Kefosai) and explicitly calls him Rabbi Akiva’s son-in-law; the forms are not harmonized.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1764&lang=en) records Kefosai alongside several other spellings in parallel sources.
The linked passage gives Ravin’s Kefosai report as an alternative to Yehoshua ben Ziruz.
